author: Leonid Popryho
method: Own router (method not disclosed). Deterministic mode: a fixed work budget instead of wall time, so every run is a pure function of instance, arguments, seed and budget. Each route is the best of many runs; some runs continue our own earlier routes, never another entry's.
hardware: AMD Ryzen Threadripper PRO 9975WX (32 cores / 64 threads), 256 GB RAM
runtime_note: runtime.json: wall-clock seconds of the whole chain of runs that produced the route (input to .sol.json), on a shared workstation
reproducibility: every route regenerates bit for bit from a recorded run manifest (instance, arguments, seed, work budget, binary hash); verified by replaying chained routes from scratch. The code is not published at this time.
